channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Erdoğan pledges support for Palestinians until two-state deal - Türkiye News
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has vowed that Türkiye would continue supporting the Palestinians in Gaza until a two-state solution is achieved, condemning what he described as ongoing atrocities in the region.

item.title: Bodrum’s Çökertme Kebab on global gastronomy list
item.description: Bodrum, one of Türkiye’s leading tourism destinations, once again highlights the culinary prestige of its registered çökertme kebab by securing the seventh spot on an international gastronomy ranking.

item.title: Türkiye braces for mild, delayed winter season - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye is set for an unusually mild winter this year, with forecasts showing temperatures well above seasonal norms across December, January and February, while rainfall is expected to remain near average levels.

item.title: Kızılelma drone fires air-to-air missile in landmark test - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye's domestically produced unmanned fighter jet Bayraktar Kızılelma became the world’s first unmanned aircraft to engage a jet-powered target using an air-to-air missile during a test in the Black Sea, officials said on Nov. 30.

item.title: Arms makers see record revenues as tensions fuel demand: report - World News
item.description: Sales by the world's top 100 arms makers reached a record $679 billion last year, as the wars in Ukraine and Gaza boosted demand, researchers said Monday, but production issues hampered deliveries.

item.title: Trump confirms call with Maduro, Caracas slams US maneuvers - World News
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed Sunday he had recently spoken with Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro amid soaring tensions between the two countries, while Caracas slammed what it called U.S. preparations for an attack.

item.title: Türkiye, Iran agree Israeli expansionism biggest threat to region - Türkiye News
item.description: The Turkish and Iranian top diplomats have agreed that the continued Israeli expansionism through attacks against Gaza, Syria and Lebanon constitutes the biggest threat to the stability and peace in the region.

item.title: Zelensky meets Macron to shore up support for Ukraine as Trump optimistic - World News
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky meets French counterpart Emmanuel Macron in Paris on Monday, seeking to shore up European support as U.S. President Donald Trump expressed optimism of a deal to end Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Militaries come to aid of Asia flood victims as toll nears 1,000 - World News
item.description: Sri Lanka and Indonesia deployed military personnel on Monday to help victims of devastating flooding that has killed nearly 1,000 people across four countries in Asia in recent days.

item.title: Pope Leo sees Erdoğan's ties as bridge to Ukraine peace - Latest News
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's ties with the leaders of Ukraine, Russia, and the US could foster dialogue, aid in reaching a ceasefire, and help find ways to end the war, Pope Leo XIV said Sunday.
